definitions.gloss: actual combat, real battle, real-world competition
definitions.explanation: Real fighting or competition as opposed to training, drills, or theory. Used in military, sports, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {実戦|じっせん}{経験|けいけん}が{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: He has abundant real combat experience.

examples.japanese: {練習|れんしゅう}だけでなく{実戦|じっせん}で{力|ちから}を{試|ため}したい。
examples.english: I want to test my abilities in real competition, not just in practice.

examples.japanese: この{武器|ぶき}は{実戦|じっせん}で{使|つか}われたことがなく、{訓練用|くんれんよう}に{開発|かいはつ}されたものだ。
examples.english: This weapon was never used in actual combat; it was developed for training.

notes:
{実戦|じっせん} combines {実|じつ} (actual, real) and {戦|せん} (battle, war).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実戦|じっせん}{経験|けいけん} (real combat experience)
- {実戦|じっせん}{配備|はいび} (deployment for actual use)
- {実戦|じっせん}{形式|けいしき} (real-match format)
- {実戦|じっせん}で{使|つか}える (usable in real situations)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実戦|じっせん} vs. {実践|じっせん}: These are homophones with different kanji and meanings. {実戦|じっせん} ({戦|せん} = battle) means "actual combat." {実践|じっせん} ({践|せん} = carry out) means "practice, putting into action." {実践|じっせん}する (to put into practice) is far more common in everyday use.
